english.島と大陸を結ぶ縦長の航海図: Tall sea chart connecting islands and continents
english.光る地点を選んで船を進め、上陸先を決めよう。: Select a glowing location to sail and choose a landing.
english.海図で行き先を選択: Choose a destination on the chart
english.甲板と乗り込み橋で戦う海上戦。砲撃の射線を見極めよう。: Fight on decks and boarding bridges. Watch the artillery firing lines.
english.城壁を破壊し、海砦の進軍路を切り開こう。: Break the walls and open a route through the sea fortress.
english.川岸と森、岩場を活かし、上陸先の拠点を確保しよう。: Use riverbanks, forests and rocks to secure a foothold.
english.隣接して設備を操作。城壁は破壊、橋は架設できます。砲台は8秒間隔で射撃。: Operate adjacent equipment. Break walls, build bridges. Artillery fires every 8 seconds.
english.船の甲板と乗り込み橋で戦う海上戦。砲撃と狙撃の射線に注意。: Fight on decks and boarding bridges. Beware artillery and sniper fire.
english.地形と架橋を活かし、拠点を結ぶ道を確保しよう。: Use terrain and bridges to connect your strongholds.
